name: Wexofy Order Summary Column for WooCommerce
author: wexofy

sections.description:
Wexofy Order Summary Column adds a configurable “Order contents” column
to the WooCommerce orders screen (both the classic and the new High-Performance
Order Storage list). Instead of clicking into every order or hovering the preview
icon, your team sees the products, quantities and key details right in the row.

What the column can show

  • Products with quantities — e.g. 2× T-shirt (SKU-123), 1× Cap
  • Product SKU, linked to the product edit screen
  • Variation attributes and product add-on / item meta
  • Product thumbnails (optional, size configurable)
  • A totals line: number of units, order total, and optionally total weight
  • Struck-through items when they have been fully refunded
  • A coloured badge on orders that contain products from categories you choose
    (e.g. flag every order with a “Made to order” or “Hazardous” product)
  • “…and X more items” collapsing for large orders

Tools

  • Filter orders by product — a product search box above the orders list that
    narrows the list to orders containing that product or any of its variations.
    Works under both classic and HPOS storage.

Settings

Everything is configurable under WooCommerce → Settings → Order Summary:
column heading, column position, how many items to show, name length, which
details to include, the category badge, and which order statuses the column
renders for (for very large stores).

Compatible with

  • WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the classic post storage
  • WooCommerce 6.5+
  • PHP 7.2 – 8.4

The plugin is completely free and fully functional. It makes no external requests
and needs no account or licence key.

sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → search for “Wexofy Order Summary Column”, Install, Activate.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Order Summary to configure it.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Orders — the new column appears automatically.
sections.faq:
Does it work with HPOS (custom order tables)?

Yes. The column and the product filter both work whether your store uses HPOS or
the classic post-based order storage.

Will it slow down the orders screen?

The column adds one order-items lookup per row. On very large stores you can
restrict rendering to specific order statuses in the settings. The product filter
uses a single indexed query and caches its result for one minute.

Can I change what the column shows?

Yes — every element (quantity, SKU, thumbnails, variation meta, totals line,
weight, refund marking, category badge) can be toggled in the settings.

2.2.2

  • Text domain changed to wexofy-order-summary-column-for-woocommerce to match the plugin slug.

2.2.1

  • Renamed to “Wexofy Order Summary Column for WooCommerce”.
  • Internal prefixes changed to wxosc.

2.2.0

  • Now a free plugin.

2.1.0

  • New: refreshed column design — framed thumbnails, monospace SKU chips, pill-style
    category badge with a soft tint derived from your chosen colour, and a divider
    above the totals line.
  • Change: totals line now reads “N units · total · weight” and sits in the footer
    next to the badge.
  • Change: product thumbnails are on by default.

2.0.0

  • New: settings screen under WooCommerce → Settings → Order Summary.
  • New: product thumbnails, variation/add-on meta, total weight, refund marking.
  • New: category badge to highlight orders containing chosen categories.
  • New: “Filter orders by product” tool for the orders screen (classic + HPOS).
  • New: configurable column position and heading.
  • Improved: HPOS support and escaping throughout.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: basic order-contents column.
